versions.changelog:
- Skill now targets validated demand for self-improving, proactive agent-style workflows, based on strong multi-source user signals.
- Workflow formalized to restate user needs, create practical plans or artifacts, minimize manual steps, and validate outputs.
- Emphasis added on local-hardware-friendly solutions (scripts, checklists, small/CPU-safe models) over cloud or large-model dependencies.
- Outputs include tailored responses, reusable assets, and quick validation notes.
- Triggers and keywords expanded to reliably capture relevant user requests for self-improvement, productivity, and adjacent workflow helper needs.
